records.title: Beyond Token Eviction: Mixed-Dimension Budget Allocation for Efficient KV Cache Compression
records.reason: MixedDimKV allocates KV dimensions per token and head; the abstract reports comparable LongBench performance at 6.25% cache and 100% needle accuracy at 50K context with 0.26% cache.

records.title: Auto-Scaling Heterogeneous Neural Processing Units for Energy and Cost-Efficient LLM Serving
records.reason: NeuScale dynamically scales heterogeneous NPU vPods for LLM inference requests; the abstract reports improved energy/cost efficiency and SLO satisfaction.

records.title: Learning What to Remember: Test-Time Training via Context Distillation
records.reason: TTCD allocates limited memory for future context using a long-window teacher and short-window student; the abstract describes inference-time adaptation of pretrained transformers with lightweight architectural augmentation.

records.title: Memorize Step by Step: Efficient Long-Context Prefilling with Incremental Memory and Decremental Chunk
records.reason: The ACL abstract introduces incremental memory and decremental chunks for long-context prefill, reporting 1.45x faster processing and 23.3% lower GPU memory than fixed-size memory.

records.title: Goose: Anisotropic Speculation Trees for Training-Free Speculative Decoding
records.reason: GOOSE uses a deep chain for reliable draft tokens and broad branches for less reliable candidates; the abstract reports 1.9–4.3x lossless speedup over autoregressive decoding.

records.title: AdaGen: Workload-Adaptive Cluster Scheduler for Latency-Optimal LLM Inference Serving
records.reason: Primary ACM abstract retrieval failed (official DOI page returned Internal Error with zero lines); retain as a source-unavailable borderline because its stable DOI and title directly indicate LLM inference-serving relevance.

records.title: Delay-Adaptive Speculation Control for Low-Latency Edge-Cloud LLM Inference
records.reason: The abstract models edge-cloud speculative draft length as a delay-dependent stopping threshold and reports up to 22.4% per-token latency reduction over SpecDec++.

records.title: Stochastic KV Routing: Enabling Adaptive Depth-Wise Cache Sharing
records.reason: The abstract trains random cross-layer attention so layers can share KV states, reducing cache memory while preserving model performance.

records.title: SpecASR: Accelerating LLM-based Automatic Speech Recognition via Speculative Decoding
records.reason: SpecASR adapts draft length, reuses prior draft sequences, and uses sparse token trees for ASR; the abstract reports decoding speedups without recognition-accuracy loss.

records.title: Speculative Verification: Exploiting Information Gain for Speculative Decoding
records.reason: The ACL abstract proposes a companion model that predicts speculative accuracy and dynamically adjusts verification length; it reports higher throughput and up to 1.9x speculative-decoding performance.

records.title: Gradient-Free Structured Pruning with Unlabeled Data
records.reason: The abstract proposes gradient-free structured pruning for pretrained language models using unlabeled data, reporting up to 40% fewer FLOPs with less than 4% accuracy loss.

records.title: Adaptive Memory Decay for Log-Linear Attention
records.reason: The abstract learns input-dependent memory decay in Fenwick-tree log-linear attention while preserving log-linear compute complexity.

records.title: Hybrid Verified Decoding: Learning to Allocate Verification in Speculative Decoding
records.reason: The abstract predicts accepted draft length to choose between cache verification and model-based drafting; it reports 2.73x average speedup on agentic workflows and reduced sequential decoding work.

records.title: Structural Pruning of Large Vision Language Models: A Comprehensive Study on Pruning Dynamics, Recovery, and Data Efficiency
records.reason: The abstract studies layerwise/widthwise pruning with lightweight recovery for LVLM deployment; it reports over 95% performance retained using 5% of recovery data.

records.title: A Survey on Model Compression and Acceleration for Pretrained Language Models
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract surveys compression and acceleration specifically for pretrained-language-model inference. The R313 row supplied a Semantic Scholar identifier and a different title wording; the exact stable arXiv URL resolves the primary record and current title/authors.

records.title: Kinetics: Rethinking Test-Time Scaling Laws
records.reason: The abstract incorporates memory-access and attention costs into test-time scaling and proposes sparse attention to lower per-token cost.

records.title: TileQ: Efficient Low-Rank Quantization of Mixture-of-Experts with 2D Tiling
records.reason: TileQ applies 2D-tiled low-rank MoE quantization and fused expert computation; its abstract reports lower memory overhead and inference latency.

records.title: TIDE: Temporal Incremental Draft Engine for Self-Improving LLM Inference
records.reason: TIDE adapts speculative drafts within a serving engine using target-model hidden states without extra target computation; the abstract reports increased workload throughput.

records.title: Fail Fast, Win Big: Rethinking the Drafting Strategy in Speculative Decoding via Diffusion LLMs
records.reason: FailFast uses a diffusion LLM to draft adaptive-length speculative continuations; the abstract reports lossless autoregressive acceleration up to 4.9x.

records.title: PureKV: Plug-and-Play KV Cache Optimization with Spatial-Temporal Sparse Attention for Vision-Language Large Models
records.reason: PureKV jointly optimizes sparse attention and KV-cache compression for VLLMs; its abstract reports 5x KV-cache compression and 3.16x prefill acceleration.
